title: Gold Prices in Pakistan Remain Steady
excerpt: Gold prices in Pakistan held steady on Saturday, keeping 24-karat gold unchanged at Rs. 429,136 per tola following a sharp movement earlier.
body_html:
Gold prices in Pakistan remained stable at the end of the week. On Saturday, the rate for 24-karat gold held steady at Rs. 429,136 per tola.

This lack of price movement followed a sharp change earlier in the period, leaving the precious metal at this specific level as trading closed for the week.
